endorsements.name: David Maloney
endorsements.label: 3rd Annual Metasploit Townhall
endorsements.description: This will be the third year of the Metasploit Townhall at DerbyCon. This will be an open forum style panel where we offer ourselves up to our community. We will answer questions, take feedback, and talk a little bit about what we've got going on and where we see things going. This is your chance to come an interact with us face to face in a setting where we can't get away! We are some, but not all, of the people who keep Metasploit going. Brent, Egyp7, and theLightCosine all work at Rapid7 where they somehow manage to get paid for doing this. ZeroSteiner is one of the core community contributors who does this for free. David - @thelightcosine Spencer - @zeroSteiner Brent - @busterbcook James - @egyp7
endorsements.subtitle: DerbyCon 2017
